model.artifact_format: PyTorch torch.save checkpoint dictionary with architecture_version, parameter_count, epoch, state_dict, metadata

training_recipe_set.index_definition: SHA-256 over sha256sum output for lexically sorted recipes/epoch-*.jsonl paths, including each file digest and relative path

signal_and_inference.source_decode: mono PCM16 WAV little-endian samples divided by 32768; no resampling
signal_and_inference.window_blend: complementary cosine fades with nonzero outer edges; divide by accumulated window weights
signal_and_inference.padding: right zero-pad incomplete last window, then trim exactly to original length
signal_and_inference.amplitude_convention: one whole-record mixture peak shared across both outputs and all windows; normalize input by peak and restore outputs by same peak; no clipping or independent output normalization
signal_and_inference.mixture_consistency: within each window add equal halves of the target-free residual (mixture minus raw heart/lung sum) to heart and lung
signal_and_inference.finite_contract: reject nonfinite input; inference output must be finite, two-source, mono and exact input length; zero input maps to two zeros; near-silent nonzero input is rejected
signal_and_inference.failure_policy: strict CPU checkpoint load and fail on missing/invalid checkpoint, shape, nonfinite values or failed inference; no fallback or method substitution

t9_protocol.authorization: separate explicit owner approval required before execution
t9_protocol.test_partition_source: only rows labeled test in the frozen source manifest; manifest sha256 is frozen above; no source identity list is copied into this specification
t9_protocol.source_ordering: sort each test source list by (family, source ID); heart outer loop, lung inner loop, then levels in ascending order
t9_protocol.crop: full 60000-sample 15-second recordings, source start 0 for both
t9_protocol.mixture_generation: existing make_mixture rule: lung_gain = RMS(heart)/RMS(lung)*10^(level_db/20); one shared scale c = 0.95/max(peak(heart), peak(scaled_lung), peak(sum)); mixture = scaled heart + scaled lung; exact IDs, hashes, gains and condition ID recorded in the test-time recipe manifest
t9_protocol.condition_identity: SHA-256 of canonical JSON recipe metadata (sorted keys, compact separators), truncated to 20 hex characters; record the float32 little-endian mixture sample SHA-256
t9_protocol.recipe_generation: only after authorization; write one immutable recipe manifest before inference and record its SHA-256; do not regenerate or alter it during evaluation

comparator_identity.fixed_filter: existing 1024-point STFT, hop 256, heart transition 180/35 Hz and lung transition 130/55 Hz; no tuning
comparator_identity.generic_nmf: existing GenericNMFExpert, 6 components, 80 iterations, seed 42 per inference window; no tuning or learned bases
comparator_identity.neossnet: excluded from final test comparison: research-only, target-domain unqualified

t9_protocol.common_inference: same generated mixtures, original full-length waveform, fixed heart/lung semantics, 4 kHz, shared whole-record peak, existing 10-second windows with 8-second hop and 2-second overlap; no reference alignment, scaling, channel swap or projection
t9_protocol.metric_definition: existing audited zero-mean SI-SDR implementation with epsilon 1e-8; SI-SDRi is same-condition estimate SI-SDR minus SI-SDR of original mixture against the same target
t9_protocol.aggregation: report per-condition rows and source-specific results; average conditions within each heart-family x lung-family group, then average groups equally for family-pair macro means; report pooled condition median and IQR descriptively; provide family-pair and relative-level breakdowns; do not treat remix conditions as independent subjects
t9_protocol.runtime: measure each inference call with monotonic wall clock; report per-method total and per-condition mean/median, plus overall elapsed time; separately report process/model initialization if available; CPU only
t9_protocol.failure_handling: record method, condition and error; do not drop failed conditions, substitute a method, or report an aggregate that excludes failures; continue the frozen matrix where execution remains safe and mark affected method incomplete; no automatic retry
t9_protocol.artifacts: under ignored implementation/.local/training/stethofuse-tcn-v1/t9/; retain frozen recipe manifest/hash, per-condition JSONL metrics/failures/runtime, summary JSON, environment and code/spec hashes; do not commit test audio or generated mixtures
t9_protocol.no_test_driven_changes: after opening test data, do not change architecture, checkpoint, seed, preprocessing, window, mixture consistency, source mapping, ensemble, weights, projection or comparators based on results
t9_protocol.bug_rerun_policy: if a concrete software defect invalidates evaluation, stop and preserve all partial evidence; document the defect and affected results; any corrected rerun requires explicit owner approval and must be identified as a correction, never tuning
t9_protocol.interpretation: describe signal separation on this frozen manikin/source-family test only; no clinical, patient-level, subject-independent or broader superiority claim
